name: markdown-editor-hardened
description: A security-hardened WYSIWYG editor for markdown. Fork of zaaack.markdown-editor with: enableCommandUris removed (closes RCE via crafted markdown command: URIs), customCss XSS vector removed, localResourceRoots scoped, CSP added, jsdelivr CDN dependency removed (vditor + Lute bundled locally), vditor bumped to 3.11.x.

markdown-editor-hardened.imageSaveFolder.description: Save images to which folder when upload in markdown, default relative to the markdown file, you can set to project root via `${projectRoot}/assets`.

markdown-editor-hardened.useVscodeThemeC.description: Use vscode theme's background color as the markdown editor's background color.

markdown-editor-hardened.customCss.description: DEPRECATED in the hardened fork — this setting was removed in T1 because raw HTML injection through `<style>` interpolation is a known XSS vector. The setting is kept here at T0 for migration honesty (so VS Code does not warn 'unknown setting') but the value is IGNORED. Use `markdown-editor-hardened.customStylesheet` (workspace-relative .css path) for stylesheet customization once T1 lands.

scripts.pub: foy build && npm version patch && git push origin master --tags && vsce package && vsce publish
